candidateOccurrences.sourceText: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

candidateOccurrences.nextContext: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.
